# About the Enterprise

ADVISOR combines sensing and analytics systems to study multimodal transportation, human behavior, and environmental conditions in real-world settings. The enterprise connects computer vision, wearable sensing, environmental monitoring, and data analytics to generate actionable insights for safe, efficient, and resilient outcomes.

## Mission

To empower researchers, practitioners, agencies, and community partners with data-driven tools that improve transportation safety, operations, and resilience.

## Vision

To advance transportation systems that are safer, more efficient, more resilient, and more responsive to human experience.
